name: VRMSIM
summary:
VRMSIM lets you load, view, and manipulate VRM models on Meta Quest.

File Storage
On first launch, these folders are automatically created:
Quest
└ Internal shared storage
  └ Android
    └ data
      └ com.AquaStratus
        └ files
          └ VRMsim
            ├ vrm
            ├ animation
            ├ audio
            └ setting

Place VRM models in vrm, VRMA files in animation, and audio files in audio. Expression data is saved automatically in setting.
